name: 多要素認証・最終ログインを含む管理ユーザー表
prompt:
Recreate only the supplied Snowflake users table crop as a faithful Japanese localization. The source is an extremely wide, shallow strip exactly 1721x121 pixels (14.22:1). Match that ultra-wide composition and compact row height; keep seven aligned columns across the full width. Do not add the search/filter toolbar, page heading, surrounding page, browser chrome, or extra rows.

Header row, left to right: 「名前」 with the small blue ascending sort arrow; 「表示名」; 「状態」; 「最終ログイン」; 「種類」; 「多要素認証」; 「所有者」. Use small uppercase-like interface typography in muted gray for normal headers, with the first header and sort arrow in blue. Preserve thin pale-gray horizontal separators.

Show exactly two visible user rows. Row one: name ALEXSMITH; display name ALEXSMITH; green status dot and 「有効」; 「38分前」; em dash for type; 「いいえ」 for MFA; small outlined user icon and ACCOUNTADMIN; three-dot row menu at the far right. Row two: name JOHNSMITH; display name John Smith; green status dot and 「有効」; em dash for last login; 「個人」 for type; 「いいえ」 for MFA; small outlined user icon and ACCOUNTADMIN; a small note/document action icon followed by a three-dot row menu at the far right. Keep the second row clipped at the exact lower edge of the shallow crop as in the reference.

Preserve the source's column widths, generous horizontal distribution, tiny type, blue active sort state, green status dots, muted values, row padding, and 1721x121 aspect. Keep every label and value on one line. Do not enlarge the table into a card, wrap text, add borders around cells, add checkboxes, or invent other data. Use the crop as the exact authority for layout and visible state.
reviewNotes: v001 preserves all seven translated columns, both visible user rows, status dots, MFA values, owner identifiers and row actions. However, ImageGen returned 2170x725 (2.99:1) with large blank bands instead of the source 1721x121 (14.22:1) table strip. Prior 10.48:1, 4.84:1 and 12.96:1 items also returned 3:1, and second reframing attempts failed, so this is recorded needs-correction after one evidence-based attempt.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
